title: Password Must Contain A Hieroglyph
style: chaotic electronic comedy, 126 BPM, glitchy synth, error beep SFX, 8-bit chiptune accents, dance-pop chorus, robotic vocoder bridge, frantic male vocal, modern internet panic energy
lyrics:
[Intro — keyboard typing, error beep, glitchy synth riser]
Create your password
We'll let you know if it's wrong

[Verse 1]
I typed in my dog's name plus the year I was born
The website laughed politely, said your password's forlorn
Add an uppercase letter, that's a minimum need
I added a B, the website said proceed

[Pre-Chorus]
Then it said add a number
I added a four
Then it said add a symbol
I added a roar of an exclamation point
That's surely enough — but no, it said
You're not even halfway through the rough stuff

[Chorus]
Password must contain a hieroglyph!
Password must contain the blood of an elf!
Password must contain a song you've never heard!
Password must contain a never-spoken word!
Sixteen characters minimum, no recent reuse
Now answer three questions about your childhood youth!

[Verse 2]
What was the name of your first imaginary friend?
What street did you live on at the world's end?
What was your favourite teacher's mother's maiden name?
What was the colour of the cat you didn't even claim?

[Pre-Chorus]
I forgot it ten minutes after I made it
I requested a reset, the system delayed it
Twenty-four hours later the email arrived
The link had expired, I died inside

[Chorus]
Password must contain a hieroglyph!
Password must contain the blood of an elf!
Password must contain a song you've never heard!
Password must contain a never-spoken word!
Sixteen characters minimum, no recent reuse
Now answer three questions about your childhood youth!

[Bridge — robotic voice, spoken]
Your password is too similar to a previous password
Your password is too similar to a future password
Your password is too similar to a password owned by a stranger
Please try again with completely original innovation
[user, defeated] I just want to check my email!

[Outro]
Password must contain a hieroglyph!
The internet has won and we have lost ourselves
Password must contain a hieroglyph!
